invariants.rationale: The input stream `data` must be non-null before the method executes to avoid NullPointerException.

meta.value: data stream must be non-null to operate on it

invariants.rationale: The flattening and mapping function must be non-null for the method to perform its operation.
The reduce function must be non-null to properly combine values when reducing by key.
The parallelism level must be at least 1, as a non-positive parallelism does not make sense for concurrency.
